scenes.title: Живой гусь  (The Live Goose)
scenes.summary: Max arrives in the kitchen eager to cook after days of unloading boxes, but Chef Barinov orders him to slaughter a live goose for tonight's VIP banquet.

scenes.title: Обед персонала  (Staff Lunch)
scenes.summary: During staff lunch, waitress Nastya passionately explains her vegetarian philosophy to cleaner Ainura, who recalls eating only potatoes in the nineties.

scenes.title: Поиски киллера  (Looking for a Hitman)
scenes.summary: Unable to kill the live goose in the backyard, Max hires cleaner Ainura to dispose of the bird for a fee of one thousand rubles.

scenes.title: Опасный разговор  (A Dangerous Conversation)
scenes.summary: A menacing prosecutor named Vadim corners Max outside Claude Monet and demands to know who Vika is seeing.

scenes.title: Паника на кухне  (Panic in the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Max panics in the kitchen that the prosecutor will destroy him, while Chef Barinov mockingly starts reciting his eulogy.

scenes.title: Ложная тревога  (A False Alarm)
scenes.summary: Max rushes to the bar to confront Kostya, only to discover to his immense relief that the scary guest was merely asking for the restroom.

scenes.title: Строгий судья  (The Strict Judge)
scenes.summary: Viktor Barinov serves a special dessert to a dining guest, only to discover she is the judge who suspended his driver license.

scenes.title: Знакомься, это Макс  (Meet Max)
scenes.summary: Max tries to swear Victoria to secrecy about their encounter, but she uses him to ward off her ex-husband Vadim by calling Max her boyfriend.

scenes.title: Разговор у барной стойки  (Conversation at the Bar)
scenes.summary: At the Claude Monet bar, Kostya tries to talk sense into Max about his feelings for Vika, arguing that a broke novice cook has no chance with the glamorous art director.

scenes.title: История про гуся  (The Story of the Goose)
scenes.summary: Max presents a dressed market goose to Chef Barinov and claims he strangled it without spilling blood, prompting Barinov to mock him as Othello and order Lyova to roast it.

scenes.title: Неловкая встреча  (An Awkward Encounter)
scenes.summary: Vadik corners Vika to talk about their secret relationship, but his wife Elvira interrupts and cheerfully praises Vika for her help, creating a deeply awkward moment.

scenes.title: Маленький гусь  (The Little Goose)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov inspects the roasted goose prepared for the banquet and is dismayed to discover that plucking its thick feathers has left almost no meat on the bird.

scenes.title: Секретное лекарство  (The Secret Medicine)
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, line cook Senya gives Chef Viktor a potent new laxative pill for revenge against the strict judge, explaining that one dose will keep her in the restroom all evening.

scenes.title: Праздничный гусь  (The Festive Goose)
scenes.summary: In the dining room, Vika and waitress Sasha coordinate the floor staff to present the roasted goose centerpiece and congratulate the birthday judge.

scenes.title: Живой гусь  (The Live Goose)
scenes.summary: Nastya discovers a live goose inside a delivery box on the kitchen floor and conspires with waitress Sasha to smuggle the bird away to safety.

scenes.title: Комплимент от шефа  (A Compliment from the Chef)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov personally serves a complimentary birthday dish to VIP guest Vadim, but hurriedly whisks the plate away when he tastes that the sauce was over-peppered.

scenes.title: Опасная ссора  (A Dangerous Quarrel)
scenes.summary: Max tries to apologize to Vika behind the restaurant, but her jealous ex Vadim bursts in and threatens them until Chef Barinov interrupts.

scenes.title: Праздничный гусь  (The Festive Goose)
scenes.summary: In the dining room, Chef Viktor Barinov proudly presents the roasted banquet goose to the VIP guest, while Max breathes a sigh of relief.

scenes.title: Итоги первой недели  (First Week Summary)
scenes.summary: After a guest apologizes for a disturbance, Chef Barinov humorously reviews Max's chaotic first week and admits he fits right into the team.

scenes.title: Посвящение на кухне  (Kitchen Initiation)
scenes.summary: The kitchen crew performs a mock ceremony to formally initiate Max into the team, prompting Max to reflect on life's gains and losses.
